rationale: The Chief Justice is best positioned to write a narrow, act-specific state-action rule keyed to whether the challenged blocking/deletion was undertaken by virtue of (or in pretense of) official authority, while preserving room for Davison/Knight-type facts. The two dissenters are likely to write (or split) to press an objective-indicia/instrument-of-governance approach, and one or more conservatives may add a concurrence to emphasize § 1983 “under color of law” limits and Halleck’s private-editorial-control caution.
